title: Fix Puzzle 2D Performance Regression Round 4: Live Cross-Pane Gesture Sync
description: Puzzle 2D board used to be very performant at the `premigration` git tag; after the migration from the bespoke `puzzle/2d/react/index.tsx` renderer to the generic framework shell + Rust/WASM BoardHost pipeline, zoom and selection now take multiple seconds. Root-cause refactor per plan at /Users/ueli/.claude/plans/puzzle-2d-used-to-piped-balloon.md: (1) restore rAF-coalesced rendering in framework/renderer/react/components/puzzle-2d-board-host.tsx (no more synchronous renderFrame()/dispatch per raw pointer/wheel event), (2) stop hover setters from bumping content_scene_generation in mathematical/graph/port/directed/normal/rs/lib.rs, (3) stop puzzle/plugin/rs/lib.rs from re-stringifying the whole fixture 3x per action, (4) parallelize framework/renderer/react/os-shell.tsx refreshUi()'s sequential awaits, (5) add spatial partitioning to hit-testing in the graph engine.
summary:
Implemented live cross-pane synchronization for the puzzle-2d triptych (overview/detail/selection), per the user's request that "all windows must be synchronized for live selection, during drag etc." — previously only synced after a gesture committed through the plugin.

Approach (matches premigration's shared-shell mechanism, adapted for the per-pane `Puzzle2dBoardHost` architecture): a module-level peer registry keyed by `controllerId`/`surfaceId` lets each pane's `BoardSession` push transient gesture state sideways into sibling sessions via existing silent, event-free WASM setters (`setNodePositionsJson`, `setSelectionIdsJsonSilent`, `setPreselectStateJsonSilent`) — never through the plugin round trip.

Changes:
- `framework/renderer/react/os-shell.tsx`: added the missing silent-setter methods to the `Puzzle2dBoardWasmSession` TS type (`setNodePositionsJson`, `setPreselectStateJsonSilent`, `setSelectionScreenPreview`, `clearSelectionScreenPreview`, plus other already-bound-but-undeclared methods).
- `framework/renderer/react/components/puzzle-2d-board-host.tsx`:
  - New `collectPuzzle2dLiveMirrorOps` pure function classifying a raw drained event batch into mirrorable ops (latest node position per id from `nodeMove`/`nodeDragEnd`, live `preselect` highlight, committed selection from `select`/`preselectCancel`).
  - New `PeerSync` region: a `controllerId -> surfaceId -> peer` registry (`registerPuzzle2dBoardPeer`/`unregisterPuzzle2dBoardPeer`/`puzzle2dBoardPeers`), a live-gesture-owner map (`beginPuzzle2dPeerGesture`/`endPuzzle2dPeerGesture`/`puzzle2dPeerOwnsGesture`), and the push helpers (`pushPuzzle2dLiveMirrorOps`, `notifyPuzzle2dPeersGestureEnded`).
  - Wired peer registration into the session-boot effect and mirror-push into `drainIntoBuffer` (the single choke point that sees every raw row before the transient-event filter).
  - Wired gesture lifecycle into `onPointerDown`/`onPointerUp`/`onPointerLeave`/Escape-cancel.
  - Added a peer-gesture-owner guard (alongside the existing `defersDescriptorSyncFromJs`/`cameraInteractionActiveRef` checks) to the fixture and selection `SceneSync` echo-apply effects, so a plugin echo arriving mid-gesture on a sibling pane defers instead of clobbering the mirrored state; deferred fixture/selection reapply on gesture-end via `applyPendingFixtureIfReady`/`applyPendingSelectionIfReady`.
- `framework/renderer/react/index.test.ts`: 8 new tests covering `collectPuzzle2dLiveMirrorOps` (nodeMove coalescing, nodeDragEnd, preselect/select/preselectCancel), the peer registry (register/unregister, exclude-self/other-controllers), gesture ownership, mirror-push targeting (skips source pane), and gesture-end notification. Full suite: 146/146 passing.
- `.claude/launch.json`: added `puzzle2d-react-dev` (port 6012, `bun run dev:puzzle:2d`) — this react-renderer dev target existed as a root package.json script but was never registered, unlike its `puzzle2d-wgpu-dev` sibling.

Verified live in the browser (dev shell :6012, Concrete Forest example): dragging a selected node in the Overview pane visibly moves it in the Selection pane mid-drag, before pointer-up (previously frozen until commit); after release all three panes converge to the same committed state with no divergence. Marquee-drag selection and undo both commit correctly and consistently across all three panes. No console errors across the full test sequence.

Not fully screenshot-verified: mid-gesture marquee/preselect highlight mirroring specifically (synthetic PointerEvent dispatch didn't reliably trigger the engine's `SelectionPending`→`Selection` transition for automated mid-gesture screenshots; real `left_click_drag` marquee only exercises the atomic pre/post state). This path shares the exact same `drainIntoBuffer` → `collectPuzzle2dLiveMirrorOps` → `pushPuzzle2dLiveMirrorOps` pipeline already confirmed live-functional for node-drag, and is covered by unit tests, but a human should double-check the live marquee highlight visually if it matters.
